substreams-websocket 0.6.2 introduces a new Substreams-to-WebSocket server for streaming blockchain table data as decoded JSON blocks.

- Provides real-time DatabaseChanges event streams over WebSockets via network@table selectors.
- Supports multiple subscription patterns, wildcards, and network lists for flexible stream selection.
- Sends a session welcome message describing streams, subscriptions, and payload envelope format.
- Broadcasts block payloads as structured JSON, stripping duplicated and provenance fields.
- Implements lifecycle messages for stream start, completion, errors, chain reorgs, and client buffer overflows.
- Designed for agents and programmatic clients needing efficient table-level blockchain data feeds.
